title: Template Manifest
description: Top-level manifest for a deck template under templates/layouts/<name>/. Lists the layouts the template provides and references its theme. Layout internals live in templates/layouts/<name>/layouts/<layout>.json.

name.description: Lowercase snake_case identifier. Must match the containing directory name.

theme_ref.description: Workspace-relative path to the theme file. Must not contain '..' or start with '/'.

items.description: Layout identifier. Must match a file at layouts/<id>.json under this template.
